h1:
Where to Stay in Koh Phangan?
11 Real-Reviewed Hotels
3 Sites Compared!
heroSub: 11 Koh Phangan hotels hand-picked across every price tier — luxury pool villas on Thong Nai Pan Noi, yoga and wellness retreats around Sri Thanu, beach bungalows at Haad Yao and Ban Tai, a resort by Haad Rin near the Full Moon Party, and a design hostel in Thong Sala. From ฿450–11,000/night.
heroStats: 🏨 5 key areas (Thong Nai Pan Noi·Sri Thanu·Thong Sala·Haad Rin·Haad Yao/Ban Tai)
introH2: 🏝️ Why does choosing the right area in Koh Phangan matter so much?
introHtml: Koh Phangan looks like one island, but each beach has a completely different feel — and the island is bigger than you'd think; driving around it takes hours. The main areas break down like this: Thong Nai Pan Noi in the north is the luxury-beach corner — clear water, white sand, mountains all around, home to the 5-star resorts — but it's 45 minutes to an hour from the pier. Sri Thanu on the west is the wellness district: yoga, detox, and sunsets facing Koh Samui. Thong Sala is the pier town — markets, restaurants, everything within walking distance. Haad Rin is Full Moon Party central, while Haad Yao and Ban Tai are quiet beachfront bungalows. Book without checking the area and you'll spend the whole day riding songthaews back and forth, tired and out of pocket. This guide rounds up 11 Koh Phangan hotels hand-picked across every tier, all with real guest reviews, 3 sites compared, and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Koh Phangan has no skytrain and no airport on the island — you arrive by ferry from Koh Samui or the Don Sak pier in Surat Thani, landing at Thong Sala. On the island you get around by songthaew (local shared taxi) or rented scooter; some roads climb steep hills, so ride carefully. Pick your area by your plans: Thong Nai Pan Noi — gorgeous clear-water beach, luxury resorts, great for a long relaxing stay, but far from the pier; most resorts run shuttles. Sri Thanu — yoga, wellness, detox, health cafés, lovely sunsets. Thong Sala — close to the pier, markets, and restaurants, perfect for first/last nights and ferry connections. Haad Rin — the Full Moon Party and its beach. Haad Yao/Ban Tai — quiet beach bungalows with snorkelling off the sand. Rates swing noticeably on Full Moon nights and in high season.

entries.name: Anantara Rasananda Koh Phangan Villas
entries.revCount: 239 reviews · highest score in this guide 9.2 · on Thong Nai Pan Noi beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thong Nai Pan Noi · north coast · beachfront

rooms.type: Ocean Pool Villa (~220 sqm, sea view)

tags: 🏖️ On Thong Nai Pan Noi beach
entries.addr: 5/5 Moo 5, Thong Nai Pan Noi Beach, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan
entries.storyHtml: Anantara Rasananda is the highest-scoring hotel in this guide at 9.2 and the top luxury pool-villa resort on Koh Phangan. What guests agree on: many villas have private pools, with a strong sense of privacy and a quiet coconut-grove setting right on Thong Nai Pan Noi beach, where the water is clear and the sand white. The Villa Host service — reachable on WhatsApp, quick to reply and attentive — gets repeated praise. It's superb for honeymoons and couples, but know that it sits 45 minutes to an hour from the pier along a winding hill road.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want a pool that gets sun all day, pick an open-aspect villa, since some private pools sit in shade and feel cold in the morning. Book the resort shuttle in advance — it's a long way out.
pros: Highest score in this guide, 9.2 · beachfront luxury pool villas
Many villas have private pools — high privacy, very quiet
Thong Nai Pan Noi beach is beautiful: clear water, white sand, mountains
Attentive Villa Host service, quick to reply on WhatsApp
cons: Remote location — 45 min to 1 hour from Thong Sala pier
Drinks in the resort are pricey · some undertow off the beach at times

entries.name: Santhiya Koh Phangan Resort & Spa
entries.revCount: 2,135 reviews · most in this guide · teak villas
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thong Nai Pan Noi · north coast · hillside by the sea
tags: 🏊 Villas with private pool + sea view
entries.addr: 22/2 Moo 5, Thong Nai Pan Noi Beach, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan
entries.storyHtml: Santhiya is the most reviewed hotel in this guide, with 2,135 reviews, and an icon of Thai teak craftsmanship on Koh Phangan, scoring 8.7. Guests consistently praise the teak woodwork and traditional Thai atmosphere unlike anywhere else on the island, the private-pool villas with sea views down the hillside, and the quiet private beach. It's ideal for relaxing and honeymoons. The thing to know: the terrain is steep, so you rely on the shuttle to get up and down — sometimes with a wait — and it's around 30 minutes from the main pier.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If your budget stretches, pick a Sea View Pool Villa — the bay view is well worth it — and allow time for the resort shuttle, since it's constant up-and-down. Not ideal if walking is difficult.
pros: Most reviewed in this guide, 2,135 · distinctive teak craft
Private-pool villas with sea views down the hillside, photogenic everywhere
Quiet private beach · Ayurvana spa and free activities well rated
Speedboat from Koh Samui reaches the resort beach in ~30 min
cons: Steep terrain — you depend on the shuttle up and down, sometimes a wait
In-resort food and drinks are pricey · far from the pier

entries.name: Panviman Resort Koh Phangan
entries.revCount: 1,782 reviews · deep review base · private beach
entries.badge: 🌊 1,782 reviews · sea views from the hill
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thong Nai Pan Noi · north coast · hillside above the beach
tags: 🌊 Wide sea views from the hill
entries.addr: 22/1 Moo 5, Thong Nai Pan Noi Beach, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan
entries.storyHtml: Panviman is a 5-star beachfront resort with a deep review base of 1,782, and better value than the two above it, starting at just ฿2,800, scoring 8.4. Highlights are the wide sea views from the hillside — many rooms look straight onto the bay — a quiet private beach with free kayaks and snorkel gear to borrow, and a kids' club plus family rooms that handle children well. Worth knowing: the grounds are very steep, so you climb stairs or rely on the golf-cart shuttle constantly, and furnishings in some rooms show the resort's age.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Call for the golf-cart shuttle whenever you need it — don't force the climb — and ask for a sea-view room when booking if you want the full bay view.
pros: Deep review base of 1,782 · 5-star beachfront at an accessible starting price
Wide sea views from the hill, many rooms face the whole bay
Quiet private beach with free kayaks and snorkel gear to borrow
Kids' club and family rooms · golf-cart shuttle on call
cons: Very steep grounds — lots of stairs or reliance on the golf cart
Some furnishings are dated · far from the pier, 45 min–1 hr

entries.name: Orion Healing Centre
entries.revCount: 344 reviews · genuine wellness centre · on Sri Thanu beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sri Thanu · west coast · heart of the wellness district
entries.storyHtml: Orion Healing is a genuine wellness centre in the heart of Sri Thanu — a Koh Phangan signature you'll barely find elsewhere, scoring 8.6 from 344 reviews. Guests rave about the seafront yoga shala where you practise at sunrise and sunset, the quality of the teachers and detox programmes, vegan food so good many forget they're eating clean, and a full recovery set-up with salt-water pool, sauna, and cold plunge. It's perfect for resetting away from the Full Moon scene — but it's alcohol-free and entirely vegan.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The fan-cooled bamboo huts are cheap but very basic with no A/C; if heat keeps you up, step up to an A/C room. Bring a torch — some inner paths are dimly lit at night.
pros: A genuine wellness centre · seafront yoga shala + daily classes
Quality yoga teachers and detox programmes, attentive care
Tasty vegan food · salt-water pool, sauna, cold plunge
On Sri Thanu beach, heart of the wellness district, calm vibe
cons: Fan-cooled bamboo huts are very basic with no A/C
Alcohol-free and fully vegan · booking admin can be slow at times

entries.name: Loyfa Natural Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sri Thanu · west coast · private-bay hillside
entries.storyHtml: Loyfa is a Sri Thanu boutique resort that sells a guests-only private bay and gorgeous sunsets facing Koh Samui, scoring 8.2 from 440 reviews. Highlights: sea-view bungalows where you open the door onto the whole bay, two hillside pools looking out to sea, free daily yoga that fits the Sri Thanu wellness scene, and a wood-fired pizza at the restaurant that guests order again. It's quiet, good for serious downtime away from the Full Moon crowd. Worth knowing: the water off the beach is shallow and rocky, hard to swim in at low tide, and the hillside means stairs to climb.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Go for a Deluxe Sea View Cottage or higher for the bay view and sunset, and if you want to swim, check the tide times first — the beach is shallow.
pros: Guests-only private bay · stunning sunsets over Koh Samui
Two hillside pools looking out to sea, calm setting
Free daily yoga, fitting the Sri Thanu wellness district
Tasty wood-fired pizza · friendly, family-style staff
cons: Shallow, rocky water off the beach — hard to swim at low tide
Hillside with stairs · some walls are thin, you hear next door

entries.name: Phangan Beach Resort
entries.revCount: 110 reviews · beachfront bungalows · near Full Moon
entries.badge: 🏖️ Beachfront value · near Full Moon yet quiet
entries.storyHtml: Phangan Beach Resort is the highest-scoring pick in the budget tier at 8.3, and the best-value beachfront option in this guide. Highlights: a beachfront spot at Ban Tai with white sand and clear water, bungalows right on the sand so you wake up to the sea, a mid-island location near enough to join the Full Moon and come back to somewhere quiet, plus a landscaped seaside pool and a beach restaurant. Worth knowing: some budget bungalows are dated, a few are fan-only, and maintenance is uneven.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For better condition, pick a renovated Deluxe Beach Bungalow; the cheaper Garden rooms are basic and some are fan-only, so check before booking.
pros: Score 8.3, top of the budget tier · bungalows right on the sand
Mid-island — close enough to join the Full Moon and sleep somewhere quiet
White sand, clear water · seaside pool and beach restaurant
Calm, private vibe, friendly staff, good value
cons: Some budget bungalows are dated with uneven maintenance
A few are fan-only · patchy Wi-Fi, reports of insects

entries.name: Araya Boutique Hotel
entries.revCount: 215 reviews · has a pool · central Thong Sala
entries.badge: 🏊 Boutique with a pool in town
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thong Sala · near the pier · town centre
entries.storyHtml: Araya Boutique is a town-centre boutique in Thong Sala with a pool from just ฿900 — rare in the centre, scoring 8.2 from 215 reviews. Highlights: an outdoor pool with some rooms offering direct pool access, a central Thong Sala location walkable to the night market, pier, restaurants, and 7-Eleven, plus clean rooms and comfy beds for the price. It's great for ferry connections and anyone who wants to be in town with a pool. Worth knowing: some rooms are compact with small bathrooms, and there's no breakfast service.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For easy pool access book a Superior Double Pool Access, but those rooms can be overlooked from outside, so privacy is limited. For breakfast, the night market nearby has options.
pros: Pool in the town centre, some rooms have direct pool access
Central Thong Sala, walk to night market, pier, and 7-Eleven
Clean rooms, comfy beds, good value for a central spot
Free parking, free Wi-Fi, shuttle service available
cons: Some rooms compact, small bathrooms, a few windowless and humid
No breakfast service · poolside rooms have limited privacy

entries.name: Tide & Tribe Hostel Phangan
entries.revCount: 40 reviews · new design · Adults Only · central Thong Sala
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thong Sala · near the pier · town centre
tags: 🚶 Walk to pier and night market
🤫 Adults Only, not a party hostel
entries.storyHtml: Tide & Tribe is a new design hostel in central Thong Sala scoring a high 8.9, and the best pick for backpackers in this guide. Highlights: it's a new, well-designed, spotlessly clean place with cool A/C dorms from just ฿450, a shared kitchen, garden, lounge, and terrace, and a central spot you can walk to straight off the ferry. It's adults-only with a quiet vibe — not a party hostel. We've ranked it carefully since the review base is still small at 40. The catch: it's not on the beach and has no pool, so you ride out to swim.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: With about 12 rooms it fills fast in high season and on Full Moon nights, so book ahead — and for couple-style privacy choose the Private Room.
pros: New, well-designed, very clean · score 8.9
Cool A/C dorms, cheapest in this guide at ฿450
Central Thong Sala, walk straight from the ferry to check in
Adults-only, quiet and safe, owner-run
cons: Not on the beach and no pool — you ride out to swim
Only ~12 rooms, fills fast when busy · review base still small

entries.name: The 1 Boutique Hotel
entries.revCount: 120 reviews · walk to the pier · central Thong Sala
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thong Sala · 5–10 min walk to the pier
tags: 🛏️ Clean rooms, cool A/C, good Wi-Fi
entries.storyHtml: The 1 Boutique is a town-centre boutique in Thong Sala that's ideal for ferry connections and first/last nights on the island, scoring 8.0 from 120 reviews. Highlights: a central Thong Sala location 5–10 minutes' walk to the pier and night market, close to restaurants, cafés, a supermarket, and ATMs, with clean rooms, cool A/C, and a good Wi-Fi signal — strong value for a central spot. Worth knowing: there's road and bar noise at night, rooms are on the small side and built for sleeping, there's no pool or sea view, and reception is open 8:00–21:00 with no late check-in.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If your ferry arrives late, tell the hotel ahead since reception closes at 9pm, and ask for an inner room away from the street for quieter nights when nearby bars are open.
pros: Central Thong Sala, 5–10 min walk to the pier and night market
Close to restaurants, cafés, supermarket, and ATMs
Clean rooms, cool A/C, good Wi-Fi signal
Strong value for a central spot, great for ferry connections
cons: Road and bar noise at night · small rooms, built for sleeping
No pool or sea view · reception 8:00–21:00, no late check-in

entries.name: Rin Beach Resort
entries.revCount: 670 reviews · deep review base · walk to pier and Full Moon
entries.badge: 🌙 On Haad Rin, walk to Full Moon
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Haad Rin Nai · near the pier · Full Moon Party
tags: 🌙 Walk to pier and Full Moon Party
entries.addr: 94/2 Moo 6, Haad Rin Nai, Koh Phangan
entries.storyHtml: Rin Beach Resort is the go-to for the Haad Rin area if you're here for the Full Moon Party, with a deep review base of 670, scoring 7.6. Highlights: a Haad Rin Nai beachfront location within walking distance of the pier and the Full Moon spot, spacious grounds, a large pool, shady gardens, and waterfront sea-view bungalows with wide balconies. It suits Full Moon visitors who want to be by the beach in the area. To be straight: the overall score is 7.6 — housekeeping and cleanliness are uneven, some bungalows are dated, water pressure is weak, and the private beach is shallow with boats moored, better for sitting than swimming.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: On Full Moon nights expect noise and book well ahead, since the area buzzes all night, and choose a renovated room or a Sea View Bungalow for better condition than the Economy rooms.
pros: Haad Rin Nai beachfront, walk to the pier and Full Moon spot
Deep review base of 670 · spacious grounds, large pool
Waterfront sea-view bungalows with wide, scenic balconies
Accessible starting price for a beachfront resort in Haad Rin
cons: Overall score 7.6 · uneven housekeeping, some bungalows dated
Weak water pressure, some rooms' A/C not cold · shallow beach with boats

entries.name: Sandy Bay Bungalows
entries.revCount: 247 reviews · Haad Yao beach bungalows · snorkelling off the sand
entries.badge: 🐠 On Haad Yao, snorkel off the beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Haad Yao · south end · west coast
tags: 🏖️ Bungalows on the sand by the sea
🐠 Snorkel the reef off the beach
entries.addr: 54/1 Moo 8, Haad Yao Beach, Koh Phangan
entries.storyHtml: Sandy Bay Bungalows closes the guide as a budget Haad Yao beachfront pick for anyone who wants to wake up to the sea and snorkel off the sand. The good: a quiet Haad Yao beachfront spot, bungalows on the sand where you wake up to the sea, snorkelling over reef right off the beach, white sand and clear water, and a lovely sunset spot — an island-chill vibe with no party. But to be straight: the overall score is 7.0 — bungalows are getting old, maintenance and service are uneven, beds are firm, and rooms aren't cleaned daily. We placed it last for honesty; it suits travellers happy with simple bungalows in exchange for a beachfront location.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a panoramic bay view choose an AC Hillside Bungalow, though it's a fair climb up the steps, and set expectations for basic rooms at this price. You can message ahead on WhatsApp.
pros: Bungalows on the sand by the sea, wake up to the water
Snorkel the reef right off the beach, white sand, clear water
West-coast sunset spot, island-chill vibe with no party
Hillside bungalows with panoramic bay views · good value beachfront
cons: Overall score 7.0 · bungalows getting old, uneven maintenance
Firm beds, not cleaned daily, swingy service · hillside means climbing steps

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Koh Phangan hotel for you?

advice.head: Special trip, luxury, honeymoon
advice.bodyHtml: → Anantara Rasananda ฿11,000 beachfront luxury pool villas, score 9.2 · or Santhiya Koh Phangan Resort & Spa ฿4,500 teak villas with sea views, most reviewed at 2,135

advice.head: Wellness, yoga, detox
advice.bodyHtml: → Orion Healing Centre ฿1,500 seafront yoga retreat in Sri Thanu, vegan food · or Loyfa Natural Resort ฿1,800 private bay, free yoga, wellness district

advice.head: Beachfront on a smaller budget
advice.bodyHtml: → Phangan Beach Resort ฿900 beachfront bungalows at Ban Tai, score 8.3 · or Sandy Bay Bungalows ฿800 on Haad Yao, snorkel off the beach

advice.head: Family with kids
advice.bodyHtml: → Panviman Resort ฿2,800 kids' club, family rooms, private beach · or Santhiya ฿4,500 multi-bedroom villas, free activities

advice.head: Ferry connection, first/last night, near the pier
advice.bodyHtml: → The 1 Boutique Hotel ฿750 5–10 min walk to the pier · or Araya Boutique Hotel ฿900 central Thong Sala with a pool

advice.head: Here for the Full Moon Party
advice.bodyHtml: → Rin Beach Resort ฿1,000 on Haad Rin, walk to the Full Moon spot · or Phangan Beach Resort ฿900 at Ban Tai, near the Full Moon but quiet to come back to

advice.head: Backpacker on a budget
advice.bodyHtml: → Tide & Tribe Hostel Phangan ฿450 central design hostel, score 8.9 · or The 1 Boutique Hotel ฿750 a private room near the pier

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate, based on standard-room ranges, and may change by date and season — always check live prices and compare 3 sites before booking. On Koh Phangan, room rates swing sharply with the season and Full Moon nights; during the Full Moon and high season prices rise and rooms fill fast, so book ahead. There's no airport on the island — you arrive by ferry from Koh Samui or Don Sak (Surat Thani), landing at Thong Sala, and get around by songthaew or rented scooter; some roads climb steep hills. faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about Koh Phangan hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in on Koh Phangan?
faq.a: It depends on your travel style · Thong Nai Pan Noi in the north is the luxury beach — clear water, good for long relaxing stays and honeymoons (Anantara Rasananda, Santhiya, Panviman) — but far from the pier · Sri Thanu on the west is the wellness district: yoga, detox, lovely sunsets (Orion Healing, Loyfa) · Thong Sala is near the pier, markets, and restaurants, good for ferry connections (The 1 Boutique, Araya, Tide & Tribe) · Haad Rin suits the Full Moon Party (Rin Beach Resort) · Haad Yao/Ban Tai are quiet beach bungalows (Sandy Bay, Phangan Beach Resort)

faq.q: ❓ How much do Koh Phangan hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: hostels and fan bungalows start around ฿450–900 a night · boutique hotels and 3-star resorts around ฿1,000–2,800 · 5-star beachfront resorts and pool villas from around ฿4,500–11,000+ · rates swing clearly with the season and Full Moon nights, rising and filling up fast during the Full Moon and high season

faq.q: ❓ Which Koh Phangan hotel has the best review scores?
faq.a: From what we compiled, Anantara Rasananda scores highest at 9.2 (beachfront luxury pool villas at Thong Nai Pan Noi), followed by Tide & Tribe Hostel at 8.9 (a design hostel, small review base) and Orion Healing at 8.6 · the deepest review bases are Santhiya at 2,135 and Panviman at 1,782, both 5-star resorts on the Thong Nai Pan Noi side

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay for wellness, yoga, or detox?
faq.a: Koh Phangan's renowned wellness district is Sri Thanu on the west coast · Orion Healing Centre ฿1,500 is a genuine wellness centre with a seafront yoga shala, daily classes, detox programmes, and vegan food · Loyfa Natural Resort ฿1,800 offers free daily yoga and a quiet private bay in the same area, good for mixing relaxation with wellness

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay for the Full Moon Party?
faq.a: The Full Moon Party is held at Haad Rin · Rin Beach Resort ฿1,000 sits on Haad Rin Nai, walkable to the party and pier, best if you want to be closest — but Full Moon nights buzz all night, so expect noise · if you want to join the Full Moon and sleep somewhere quiet, Phangan Beach Resort ฿900 at Ban Tai is mid-island, letting you go and return to quiet · both fill fast for the Full Moon, so book well ahead

faq.q: ❓ How do I get to Koh Phangan and around the island?
faq.a: Koh Phangan has no airport on the island — you arrive by ferry from Koh Samui or the Don Sak pier in Surat Thani, landing at Thong Sala (some luxury resorts run speedboats to their beach) · on the island you get around by songthaew (local shared taxi) or rented scooter · the island is bigger than it looks and some roads climb steep hills, so ride carefully · most Thong Nai Pan Noi resorts run shuttles, which you should book ahead given the distance
